videos.title: Minecraft: Disorder of the Stone - Server Tour
videos.description:
Hi. Sorry for not uploading, I was busy playtesting.

Disorder of the Stone, as stated in the video, will be playable. It's not smoke and mirrors like some similar content. It's less 'ARG' and more 'unfiction'. 

The 'minecrafty05' persona seen in the video is part of this being unfiction. For the purposes of storytelling, they are presented as a different person, which is also why they state they are a child.
There's no weird intentions behind this.

I don't know when it'll release, but I'm working to get it out as soon as possible. When it's finished, it'll be available on Modrinth only.

Please don't ask anyone listed in the credits for early access.

( Music by https://nuclearcrackhead-239.bandcamp.com/ )
